prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production asset: ONE coherent 3-by-3 game prop atlas on genuine transparent background. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Match its vintage American horror comic ink and colored-pencil drawing: rough black contours, sparse angular hatching, aged cream bone, muted ochre, plum purple, faded mint and rust red. No glossy 3D or realistic lighting. The game is the moonlit masked-versus-skeleton volleyball game shown.
Exact registration: a square canvas divided invisibly into NINE EQUAL square cells in a precise 3 by 3 grid. One isolated prop fully centered in each cell, with 12 percent empty padding on every edge. Nothing crosses a cell boundary. True alpha between and around props; no labels, no borders, no contact shadows, no colored backing, no checkerboard drawing.
Cell order left-to-right, top-to-bottom:
1) A chunky haunted U-shaped horseshoe magnet opening toward RIGHT, rust-red upper pole, mint lower pole, black iron body, small bone rivets. Recognizable silhouette.
2) A squat hooded voodoo puppet HEAD AND TORSO ONLY with stitched burlap face and plum cowl, cream buttons for eyes, no arms or legs. It will have separately animated skeletal boxing arms in code. Keep the figure compact.
3) A grinning cream skull facing RIGHT, trailing short torn ochre/rust flames to the LEFT. Compact flying fire-skull silhouette.
4) A shallow LOWER skeletal jaw / trap base viewed from the FRONT, horizontal and wide, ivory worn bone, small teeth point UP. No spring or upper jaw attached.
5) The matching UPPER skeletal jaw / trap cap viewed from the FRONT, horizontal and wide, small teeth point DOWN. No spring or lower jaw attached.
6) A small asymmetrical mint-green ectoplasm slime creature with hollow black eyes and a skull-like mouth, black contour and violet shadows, little dangling goo drips. No jar, no machine.
7) A front-facing plum-purple BAT with wide spread angular wings, cream eyes and little pointed ears. Nothing carried. Thin ragged membranes and strong readable black contour. The wings must fit fully within the cell.
8) A round ochre wax-seal TALISMAN with ragged paper ribbon ends, thick black contour. Leave a clear empty circular cream centre, which receives a distinct power glyph in code. No letters or pre-drawn symbol in centre.
9) A single small clenched PLUM cloth BOXING FIST facing RIGHT, stitched fabric, cream knuckle band, rough ink outline. Isolated without arm.
All props belong to the same illustrated asset atlas and should share line weight and paper/pencil surface detail. Readable when displayed at 25-65 pixels. Moderate pencil tooth only: animated procedural grain is applied at runtime. No text, no hotel objects, no service robots, no modern UI, no gore.
